_comment: How much of each field the tree shows.

field._comment: Each flag is described in display.ts.

collection._comment: The source's own name beside the collection label, e.g. `Patient` next to `Patient records`.

_labelOverridesComment: Labels for identifiers that humanise badly, keyed by the source's own name.
_preserveWordsComment: Words and phrases sentence-casing must not lower, matched case-insensitively on whole words and shown as written here. A deployment's own vocabulary, so the platform ships none.
